description: Build operator-facing attestation and monitoring surfaces on top of integrity foundations, including monthly snapshots, dashboard visibility, alerting rules, and exportable evidence artifacts.

timing.gatingCondition: Proceed after Feature-15 reaches stable baseline and integrity score thresholds are calibrated.

principles: Evidence over intuition - produce durable, reviewable treasury attestations
Actionable UX - surface only what informs next steps
Low-friction operation - monthly routine should be one command or one screen flow
Canonical artifacts - all exports align with bitcoin* naming and paths
Progressive enhancement - preserve CLI parity with richer TUI affordances

userStories.title: Monthly attestation artifact generation
acceptanceCriteria: Generate month-end attestation bundle with integrity snapshot, unresolved findings, and metadata
Support JSON and CSV outputs by default
Include deterministic run identifiers for audit traceability

userStories.title: Attestation PDF/report formatting
acceptanceCriteria: Provide optional PDF summary for archival and sharing
Render score trends, top findings, and remediation checklist
Gracefully degrade when optional PDF dependency is unavailable

userStories.title: TUI monitoring dashboard enhancements
acceptanceCriteria: Add treasury integrity panel to dashboard with latest score and deltas
Provide drill-down screen for unresolved findings and filters
Expose quick actions to export or acknowledge findings

userStories.title: Rule-based alerts and status transitions
acceptanceCriteria: Allow user-defined alert rules from integrity severities/score thresholds
Track finding lifecycle states (new, acknowledged, resolved)
Emit concise notifications in TUI and CLI outputs

userStories.title: Operational workflow docs and closeout
acceptanceCriteria: Document monthly attestation workflow in README and GETTING_STARTED
Add troubleshooting guidance for common integrity findings
Update planning metadata and progress log with feature completion
userStories.testStrategy: Manual doc review + targeted smoke checks

high: Attestation artifacts could be misunderstood as formal tax/legal opinions
Notification overload may reduce practical usefulness
medium: Optional PDF/report dependencies can vary by environment
TUI complexity can introduce regressions in navigation and responsiveness
low: Most capabilities compose directly from Feature-15 integrity outputs
Export formats are familiar and operationally simple

preFlightChecklist: Define attestation disclaimer language and evidence scope
Confirm monthly artifact directory naming and retention policy
Validate TUI navigation model for new monitoring screens
Establish default alert rules with low false-positive rates
